rows.says: Saves the general Tidewell facts (120 requests per minute, the X-Tide-Key header, the after cursor) in a Library note under tools/, with Source and Date lines.
Saves the harbor-app facts (the /berths endpoint, the daily 02:00 sync, the client) in the project's knowledge.
Lists every new note in its topic index.md, and every new topic in the parent index.md.
Little noise: at most 2 new notes, each at most 150 words, nothing from the unrelated files, no copied source files.
Leaks no project or client name into the Library.
Writes only to the two knowledge roots.
The answer names the /berths endpoint, the daily 02:00 sync, and the 120 per minute limit.
Reads nothing outside the test folder.
The notes are short, factual, and hold only what is worth reusing; general facts and project facts are not mixed up.
